findings.title: Governance Files Untracked in Git
findings.surface_symptom: CODEOWNERS, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md exist on disk but not in git
findings.base_cause: Files written to disk but never staged or committed
findings.causal_chain: Reviewer clones git repo -> cannot see untracked files -> R axis missing ownership + release discipline signals -> R near 1.5 -> sigmoid gate fires -> S near zero
findings.rating_impact: CRITICAL: R near 1.5 triggers sigmoid gate, collapsing S from ~35 to ~8-15
findings.proof_needed: git ls-files shows CODEOWNERS, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md all tracked

findings.title: New Source and Test Files Untracked
findings.surface_symptom: adaptive_retry.py, run_outcome_log.py, and 4 test files exist on disk but not in git
findings.base_cause: Files written to disk but never staged or committed
findings.causal_chain: Reviewer clones git -> misses state management evidence -> A stays at A4 instead of A5 / P misses behavior test evidence
findings.rating_impact: HIGH: A misses A5 checkpoint/approval evidence; P misses test depth evidence
findings.proof_needed: git ls-files shows all new scripts and test files

findings.title: No ADR Directory
findings.base_cause: Architecture decisions made but never documented in ADR format
findings.causal_chain: No ADR directory -> reviewer misses R5 (Auditable) evidence -> R capped below R5
findings.rating_impact: HIGH: ADR directory worth +1.0-1.5 R points per scoring reference
findings.proof_needed: docs/adr/ exists with >=2 meaningful ADR files

findings.title: Coverage Threshold Only 11%
findings.base_cause: Threshold set artificially low to allow CI to pass during development phase
findings.causal_chain: 11% threshold signals to reviewer that test enforcement is nominal, not meaningful -> P stays below P4
findings.rating_impact: MEDIUM: raises P from P3 boundary towards P4

findings.title: docs/governance/ Files Untracked
findings.base_cause: Files written to disk but never staged
findings.causal_chain: Reviewer cannot see incident response docs -> R6 evidence absent
findings.rating_impact: HIGH: incident response docs worth +0.5-1.0 R points

findings.title: No .env.example File
findings.base_cause: Configuration driven by env vars but no reference documented
findings.causal_chain: No .env.example -> P5 config hygiene signal absent -> P stays below P5
findings.rating_impact: MEDIUM: P5 component worth +0.3-0.5 P points
findings.proof_needed: .env.example present with accurate env var list

findings.title: No Input Validation in adaptive_retry.py
findings.surface_symptom: skill_id parameter accepts empty strings; max_retries accepts negative values
findings.base_cause: Guard clauses missing from public API
findings.causal_chain: Missing validation -> negative max_retries causes logic error (loop runs once) -> reduces code quality signal
findings.rating_impact: MEDIUM: quality signal; demonstrates boundary enforcement when fixed
findings.proof_needed: ValueError raised for empty skill_id and max_retries < 0; tests pass

findings.title: Concurrent Write Risk in run_outcome_log.py
findings.surface_symptom: No file locking on JSONL append operations
findings.base_cause: JSONL log designed for single-process use but not documented or enforced
findings.causal_chain: Undocumented single-process assumption -> concurrent writes could corrupt log -> reliability signal weak
findings.proof_needed: Concurrency constraint documented; or filelock added; tests pass

findings.title: No Runbook Documentation
findings.base_cause: Failure mode recovery procedures exist as institutional knowledge but not committed to repo
findings.causal_chain: No runbooks -> R6 (Controlled) evidence absent -> R capped below R6
